meta.notes: A point_of_interest_type tag gives one name to several point_of_interest_type ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. Vanilla uses #minecraft:acquirable_job_site for the blocks a villager can take a job at and #minecraft:bee_home for hives and nests; a tag of your own such as #msm_examples:ranged_job_sites is for grouping and reuse.
